rows.en:
(Today's the day of Sheryl's concert
I've been waiting for.)

(Just thinking I'll meet the Galactic Fairy
makes me nervous. I've gotta be careful
not to mess up during the real show...)
Listen to my song~~!!!
rows.notes: Sheryl's signature line, full force. Shared M/F.

rows.en:
Sheryl Nome
A top idol known as the "Galactic Fairy"
Visiting the Frontier fleet on her galactic tour
Amazing...!
The Galactic Fairy......
(So this is the Galactic Fairy's performance...)

(I get to see something this amazing up close...
I'm really glad I got to be part of
Sheryl's concert...)
Whoa, can't stand around gawking forever.

Hey, \p.
We're on soon.
Don't just stand there spacing out.
Y-yeah... I know, Michel.
Then let's go!

(All right! I'll show them acrobatics that
can hold their own against Sheryl's song!!)

Geez, that Alto, pulling something
that reckless...

But that sure was a shock, wasn't it?
Sheryl suddenly doing something that
wasn't in the program.

Yeah, really.
Those of us covering for Alto were pretty
rattled too.

(I guess she's free-spirited, just like you'd
expect from someone called the Galactic Fairy......)
Huh?! An evacuation alert?!
Let's go, Luca, \p.
What on earth is going on, Michel?

Apparently the Frontier fleet is under attack
by unidentified creatures that appeared
out of nowhere.

Looks like the U.N. Government has also
issued a sortie request to S.M.S.
rows.notes: Tougou seifu: per the brief tougou = U.N.; glossary has only chikyuu tougou seifu 'U.N. Government' / shin tougou seifu 'New U.N. Government'. Shared M/F.

rows.en:
Our orders are to get back to S.M.S. right away
and sortie immediately.

Looks like this is going to be
your first real combat.

(Real combat...
Not the simulator, a real battle...!)
You ready to sortie, \p?
Hey! Are you listening?!
Ah! Y-yeah... Sorry, Michel.

This isn't training!
You'll get yourself killed like that!!

(That's right, this isn't training.
If I get shot down, what's waiting for me is...)
rows.notes: Trails off as in the Japanese.

rows.en: There's only one thing I can tell you.
......Don't die.
...Right!
All right! We're heading out too!!
(I'm coming back alive, no matter what!)

(Today's the day of Sheryl's concert
I've been waiting for.)

(Just thinking I'll meet the Galactic Fairy
makes me nervous. I've gotta be careful
not to mess up during the real show...)
Y-yeah... I know, Michel-kun.

(All right! I'll show them acrobatics that
can hold their own against Sheryl's song!!)

Yeah, really.
Those of us covering for Saotome-kun were
pretty rattled too.

(I guess she's free-spirited, just like you'd
expect from someone called the Galactic Fairy......)
What on earth is going on, Michel-kun?
Ah! Y-yeah... Sorry, Michel-kun.

(That's right, this isn't training.
If I get shot down, what's waiting for me is...)
(I'm coming back alive, no matter what!)

(Phew... I nearly got taken out,
but somehow I made it back in one piece...)

It was your first real combat.
Just making it back in one piece is good enough.

(Phew... Looks like I made it back
in one piece.)

Not bad for your first real combat.
Keep it up.

(What the heck were those things?
In the end, I couldn't even tell what they
were after...)
(I hope this is the end of the fighting...)

(Phew... I nearly got taken out,
but somehow I made it back in one piece...)

(Phew... Looks like I made it back
in one piece.)

(What on earth were those things?
In the end, I couldn't even tell what they
were after...)

(Still, what a surprise.
Who'd have thought Alto would join S.M.S....)

(Sounds like Captain Ozma and the others are
putting him through the wringer, but hey,
Alto'll be fine.)
rows.notes: Aligned to the glossary decision of 2026-10-17.

rows.en:
(There haven't been any Vajra attacks since then...
I hope things stay quiet like this......)

Emergency notice.
Distress call received from the Galaxy fleet.
Commencing rescue operation. Repeat...
(A distress call from the Galaxy fleet?!)

The Vajra have attacked the Galaxy fleet,
and it's now in critical danger.
(No way... the Galaxy fleet......)

This mission, on Sheryl's order, is to rescue
the Galaxy fleet's evacuee ships.
rows.notes: Sheryl no oodaa: she ordered (commissioned) the mission. Shared M/F.

rows.en:
Mission code: "Galactic Fairy"!
Let's go!

(Still, what a surprise.
Who'd have thought Saotome-kun would join
S.M.S....)

(Sounds like Captain Ozma and the others are
putting him through the wringer, but
Saotome-kun will be fine.)
rows.notes: Aligned to the glossary decision of 2026-10-17.

rows.en:
(The mission seems to have succeeded,
but I think I held everyone back...)

(Who'd have thought the Vajra would follow the
Galaxy refugee ships and attack the
Frontier fleet...)

(Thanks to Alto and the others, it looks like
we somehow managed to protect it...)
rows.notes: Object (the fleet) carried from the previous row.

rows.en:
(I don't think the Vajra attacks will end here...
If they show up again, I'll protect Frontier myself!)

(The mission seems to have succeeded,
but I think I held everyone back...)

(Thanks to Saotome-kun and the others, it looks
like we somehow managed to protect it...)

(I don't think the Vajra attacks will end here...
If they show up again, I'll protect Frontier myself!)
